be surrounded by friends: On her birthday, Lisa was surrounded by friends who sang to her and brought her a huge cake.
生日那天，莉莎被朋友圍繞，他們為她唱歌，還帶來一個超大的蛋糕。
surround oneself with: If you want to stay positive, you should surround yourself with people who encourage you instead of laughing at you.
如果你想保持積極，就應該讓自己身邊都是會鼓勵你、而不是嘲笑你的人。
the mystery surrounding: Scientists are still trying to solve the mystery surrounding the strange lights seen over the ocean last year.
科學家仍在試圖解開圍繞著去年海上出現的奇怪光線的謎團。
surround the building: Dozens of police cars arrived to surround the building and block every exit, so the robber had no way out.
數十輛警車趕到，包圍了建築並封鎖每一個出口，搶匪因此無路可逃。
controversy surrounds: A lot of controversy surrounds the plan to build a new airport, because many people worry about the noise.
興建新機場的計畫爭議不斷，因為很多人擔心噪音問題。
survey the damage: The morning after the earthquake, the mayor walked through the old town to survey the damage to the buildings.
地震隔天早上，市長走遍老城區勘查建築物的損害。
survey public opinion: Before choosing a new school uniform, the student council decided to survey public opinion by asking every class.
在選擇新校服之前，學生會決定詢問每個班級來調查民意。
survey the scene: The detective stood quietly at the door to survey the scene of the crime before touching anything.
偵探安靜地站在門口環視犯罪現場，然後才去碰任何東西。
survey the land: Before the new road can be built, workers must survey the land to find out its exact size and shape.
在新道路動工之前，工人必須先測量土地，以得知它確切的大小和形狀。
survive a crash: It was a miracle that all the passengers were able to survive a crash in the snowy mountains last winter.
去年冬天所有乘客都能在雪山的空難中生還，真是奇蹟。
survive on little: During the war, many families had to survive on little more than rice and a few vegetables each day.
戰爭期間，許多家庭每天只能靠很少的米和幾樣蔬菜維生。
survive the winter: Bears eat a lot in autumn and then sleep for months so they can survive the winter without food.
熊在秋天大量進食，然後睡上好幾個月，好在沒有食物的情況下熬過冬天。
survive the test of time: Some of Shakespeare's plays have managed to survive the test of time and are still loved by audiences today.
莎士比亞的一些劇作經得起時間考驗，至今仍深受觀眾喜愛。
survive one's wife: My grandfather was able to survive his wife by twelve years, and he visited her grave every Sunday.
我的祖父比他的妻子多活了十二年，他每個星期天都去她的墓前探望。
barely survive: Many small shops could barely survive during the pandemic because so few customers came to buy anything.
疫情期間許多小商店只能勉強存活，因為很少有顧客上門購物。
suspect foul play: The man's death looked like an accident, but the police suspect foul play because his door was broken.
這名男子的死看起來像是意外，但警方懷疑有不法情事，因為他的門被破壞了。
suspect someone of: The shop owner seemed to suspect someone of stealing money, so he put a camera above the cash register.
店主似乎懷疑某人偷錢，所以他在收銀機上方裝了一台攝影機。
I suspect that: My cake is missing from the fridge, and I suspect that my little brother ate it, but I have no proof yet.
我的蛋糕從冰箱裡不見了，我懷疑是我弟弟吃掉的，但我還沒有證據。
a suspected case: The hospital reported a suspected case of dengue fever and asked the patient's family to stay at home for tests.
醫院通報了一起疑似登革熱的病例，並要求病患家屬待在家中等候檢驗。
prime suspect: Because his fingerprints were found on the window, the neighbor became the prime suspect in the robbery case.
由於窗戶上發現了他的指紋，那位鄰居成了這起搶案的頭號嫌犯。
suspend a student: The school decided to suspend a student for three days after he started a fight in the cafeteria.
一名學生在餐廳打架後，學校決定讓他停學三天。
suspend operations: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport had to suspend operations, and hundreds of flights were cancelled.
由於強烈颱風，機場不得不暫停營運，數百個航班被取消。
suspend judgment: Before you decide who is right, please suspend judgment until you have heard both sides of the story.
在你決定誰對之前，請先暫不評斷，直到你聽完雙方的說法。
suspend payment: If the company keeps sending broken products, we will suspend payment until the problem is fixed.
如果這家公司持續寄來損壞的產品，我們將暫停付款，直到問題解決為止。
be suspended from the ceiling: A huge old lamp has been suspended from the ceiling of the hall for over fifty years.
一盞巨大的舊吊燈從大廳的天花板垂下已經超過五十年了。
suspend disbelief: To enjoy a movie about flying cats, you need to suspend disbelief and just accept the strange world on the screen.
要享受一部關於會飛的貓的電影，你得暫時相信，接受銀幕上那個奇怪的世界。
suspended sentence: Since it was his first crime, the young driver was given a suspended sentence instead of being sent to prison.
由於這是他第一次犯罪，這名年輕駕駛被判緩刑，而沒有被送進監獄。
sustain growth: To sustain growth over the next ten years, the company plans to open new stores in Southeast Asia.
為了在未來十年維持成長，這家公司計畫在東南亞開設新店。
sustain injuries: Two riders sustained injuries when their scooters crashed on the wet road, but luckily neither was badly hurt.
兩名騎士的機車在濕滑的路上相撞而受傷，但幸好兩人傷勢都不嚴重。
sustain life: Scientists are looking for planets with water, because water is needed to sustain life as we know it.
科學家正在尋找有水的行星，因為就我們所知，水是維持生命所必需的。
sustain an argument: In a debate, you need strong facts to sustain an argument; otherwise the judges will not accept your point.
在辯論中，你需要有力的事實來支持論點，否則評審不會接受你的觀點。
sustain interest: Our teacher uses games and short videos to sustain interest during long grammar lessons.
我們老師在冗長的文法課中使用遊戲和短片來維持大家的興趣。
sustain losses: Fruit farmers will sustain losses of millions of dollars because the heavy rain destroyed most of their mangoes.
果農將蒙受數百萬元的損失，因為大雨毀了他們大部分的芒果。
sustain damage: Several houses near the beach sustained damage during the storm, and some lost their roofs completely.
海邊的幾棟房子在暴風雨中受損，有些甚至整個屋頂都不見了。
